title: Du‘a for a good start – Rabbi yassir
intro: Before everything we do, we ask Allah to make it easy and blessed.

learn.alt: A girl in a pink headscarf raising her hands in du‘a

learn.html: Success and help in everything we do come from Allah, the All-Powerful. That is why, before every task, we say Rabbi yassir. With this du‘a we ask Allah to make our work easy, blessed and happy.

learn.label: Rabbi yassir
learn.ar: رَبِّ يَسِّرْ وَلَا تُعَسِّرْ رَبِّ تَمِّمْ بِالْخَيْرِ
learn.tr: Rabbi yassir wa laa tu‘assir, Rabbi tammim bil-khayr. Aameen!
learn.en: My Lord, make it easy and do not make it hard. My Lord, complete it with good. Ameen – O Allah, answer us!

learn.html:
Fatima said A‘udhu billah and Bismillah,
full of joy;
she learned Rabbi yassir
and started with her very first du‘a.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: We say Rabbi yassir before we start something: our homework, a test, a trip, helping at home…

practice.title: Build the du‘a
practice.prompt: Tap the words in the right order.

practice.title: When do we say Rabbi yassir?
practice.prompt: Tap every time it is good to say Rabbi yassir, then tap Check.

options.why: We ask Allah’s help only for good things – never for something bad.

questions.q: Who gives us success and help in what we do?
What do we ask Allah for when we say Rabbi yassir?
options: To make our work easy and blessed

questions.q: What does “Rabbi yassir wa laa tu‘assir” mean?
options: My Lord, make it easy and do not make it hard
My Lord, increase me in knowledge
My Lord, complete it with good
My Lord is enough for me
There is no god except Allah

questions.q: What did Fatima say before Rabbi yassir?

prompts: 💬 When would you say Rabbi yassir?
